contract.name: CollectContract
contract.desc:
F1 Collect — NFT Card Minting & Marketplace Smart Contract
    ARC-4 ABI compatible, deployable via Lora using ARC-32 JSON spec.

methods.name: create_application

args.name: minter
args.desc: x402 backend server wallet (authorized to call mint_card)

methods.desc:
Initialize CollectContract on deployment.
Sets admin = deployer, minter = x402 backend wallet. Resets all counters to 0.

methods.name: create_card_template
methods.desc:
Admin creates an F1 card template and its ASA on-chain.
Steps:   1. Validates admin + inputs   2. Creates ASA via inner transaction (the NFT)   3. Stores CardTemplate struct in a Box   4. Returns the new card_id

methods.name: mint_card
methods.desc:
Mint 1 NFT from a card template to a recipient.
Called by the x402 backend after ALGO payment is verified.
Only admin or authorized minter can call this.

methods.name: burn_card
methods.desc:
Burn an NFT permanently on-chain.
User must send the NFT to the contract in the same atomic group.

methods.name: list_for_sale
methods.desc:
List an NFT on the secondary market (escrow-based).
User must send the NFT to the contract in the same atomic group.

methods.name: cancel_listing
methods.desc:
Cancel a secondary market listing and return NFT to seller.
Only the original seller or admin can cancel.

methods.name: set_minter
methods.desc: Admin updates the authorized minter address.

methods.name: deactivate_card
methods.desc: Admin disables minting for a card template (e.g. sold out).

methods.name: get_card_template
methods.desc: Get full details of a card template by ID.

methods.name: get_total_cards
methods.desc: Get total number of card templates created.

methods.name: get_total_minted
methods.desc: Get total NFTs minted across all card types.

methods.name: is_burned
methods.desc: Check if an NFT has been burned.

methods.name: get_total_listings
methods.desc: Get total number of listings ever created.

methods.name: get_minter
methods.desc: Get the authorized minter wallet address.
